expectations.text: States that Lovable produces web apps, not native store-submittable mobile apps
expectations.evidence: Caveat 1: 'It cannot build a native mobile app... web-only platform... publishing always ends at a web URL'

expectations.text: Gives concrete builder-selection criteria including pricing model and code ownership/export
expectations.evidence: Discusses Lovable credit pricing ('the cost is the credits, not the plan') and ownership ('GitHub export so you're never locked in'); compares alternatives with prices

expectations.text: Advises validating the idea (prototype + real users) before investing in the real build
expectations.evidence: Guardrail 'Ship order: prototype -> show your sister -> fix -> pilot with 5 friendly clients -> security review -> then real bookings'
